title: UPDATED!!  INF REBIRTH AND INFINITE UPGRADES KEYLESS
features:
Main Tab

Infinite Rebirths — Auto: Toggle ON/OFF 

Infinite Upgrades — Auto: Toggle ON/OFF 

Auto Win Tab 

Mark Spot: Point your mouse at a surface (e.g., win pad), then press M (or custom keybind) to save the position. Check the "Saved Position" label for coordinates.

TP Loop: Toggle ON/OFF 

Settings Tab

Toggle UI: Press G (or custom keybind) to show/hide the GUI.

Rejoin: Click to instantly rejoin the current game server.

UI Controls

Draggable Window: Click and drag the Rayfield window to move it.

Toggle Key: Press G (or custom keybind) to hide/show the hub.
